note: Status: Requirement given - Gen flow (no OCMS flow deck; steps taken from the story text). The story asks the screen to prompt whether the scheduled email sending and the rejection succeeded. After Submit, an alert modal shows 'Furnish rejected successfully.' and, when an email was sent, 'The email/SMS has been sent to the recipient.'; a reject failure shows an error message, an email failure shows 'Email/SMS was not successfully sent to the recipient(s).'. Because there is no scheduling, the message says 'sent', not 'scheduled'. Which recipient failed is not shown (res2.error is not passed into the message). No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Claim mostly: result prompts for reject and email exist. No 'scheduled' wording because scheduling is not built

steps.step: The screen prompts that the rejection succeeded
steps.detail: When the reject API succeeds, successMsg = 'Furnish rejected successfully.' (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:210-212) and it is shown through a non-error setModalAlr; closing the modal reloads the page in UPDATE mode (ActionNotice.tsx:260-273).

steps.step: The screen prompts that the email was scheduled/sent successfully
steps.detail: When composeFurnish succeeds, the message becomes 'Furnish rejected successfully. The email/SMS has been sent to the recipient.' (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:223-225). The prompt exists, but it says 'sent', not 'scheduled', because the email is indeed sent immediately (useFurnishAPI.ts:181-188; see OCMS41.29 step 4).

steps.step: If the reject or the email fails, the screen shows that status
steps.detail: A reject failure fills result.error and an error modal appears (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:202-207; ActionNotice.tsx:278-285). An email failure appends 'Email/SMS was not successfully sent to the recipient(s).' to the reject success message (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:218-221). Which recipient failed is not named because res2.error is dropped.
